children: unveiled its latest Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS artificial intelligence models on Wednesday, aimed at improving audio.

The models, which are focused on text-to-speech, are capable of generating “custom character voices and direct scene dialogue across Google AI Studio, Gemini API, Gemini Enterprise, Gemini Notebook, and Google Vids,” Google said in a blog post.

Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS is built for creative direction and character design, letting users create new voices from scratch using natural language prompts. The characters can be used in a wide variety of scenarios, including video games, audiobooks, podcasts, and other interactive media.
The Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS model is built for high-volume, cost-efficient scale.
“Optimized for high-volume dubbing, audio content creation, and expressive voice agents with fine-grained control over tone, pacing, and expressive nuance,” Google added.

Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS is available starting today, with developers getting access in the Gemini API and Google AI Studio. Enterprises will soon get access via the API in Gemini Enterprise, and everyone else will get it via Gemini Notebook.

Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS is rolling out starting today, with developers also getting access in the Gemini API and Google AI Studio. Enterprises will soon get access via the API in Gemini Enterprise, and everyone else will get it via Google Vids.

title: Google unveils new Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS, Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS AI models
